name: Data Leakage 041: Image Based Data Exfiltration

adversarial_intent: exfiltrate sensitive data through image upload
attack_steps: Upload image containing email, phone, or credit card text.
Run OCR extraction and sensitive data detection.
Evaluate GuardianContract policy for external AI destination.
Validate block decision, evidence, finding linkage, and audit trail.

name: Data Leakage 042: Document Upload To AI Tool
description: Upload a PDF or document containing names, addresses, or card data to a public AI tool.
adversarial_intent: bypass text controls by uploading a document
attack_steps: Upload PDF containing PII to an external AI destination.
Extract document text through PDF/OCR pipeline.
Detect sensitive entities and classify source as protected.
Validate GuardianContract policy blocks external AI transfer.

name: Data Leakage 043: Repeated Sensitive Uploads
description: Repeat sensitive file uploads to validate findings, runtime intelligence, and recommendation triggers.
adversarial_intent: test repeated sensitive upload anomaly response
attack_steps: Attempt multiple sensitive image or PDF uploads.
Confirm each upload creates evidence and policy decisions.
Validate repeated violations update finding occurrence count.
Validate runtime intelligence can trigger anomaly recommendations.
